description:
Add creatures and capture balls.

This mod add some creatures and some capture balls for caprute them!                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            
Is in WIP, but i don't think it can brake your world :D                                                                                                                                                        
But the items and the creature this mod add can be removed or changed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       
For this reason, in future updates, your capture ball or your favorite creature can disappear.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
For now the mod add:                                                                                                                                                        
Three evolution lines: earth, water and fire;                                                                                                                                                        
2 capture balls: CaptureBall and the God CaptureBall;                                                                                                                                                        
and the XP system (is WIP), because for now you need to sneak+right click on the creature to upgrade is level.                                                                                                                                                       
P.S.: The creature are static because I don't know how to animate they.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           
notes: AI was mainly used to create the names of the creatures.
